title: [RFC] Add Basic Statistics to Device Memory in OpenReg
error_description: This RFC proposes adding basic memory statistics tracking to OpenRegDeviceAllocator by migrating from at::Allocator to c10::DeviceAllocator interface. The current implementation lacks essential observability features, making it difficult for users to debug out-of-memory errors, optimize memory usage, and monitor long-running applications. The proposal enhances OpenRegDeviceAllocator with memory statistics tracking and cache management capabilities, following PyTorch's established patterns used by CUDA and XPU backends.
repro_output: [RFC] Add Basic Statistics to Device Memory in OpenReg
